parole.significato: A man who behaves in an effeminate manner.
parole.testo: From Tongan fakaleitī; the second part comes from English lady.

parole.significato: Any member of the species Piper methysticum, a plant from the South Pacific.
parole.testo: From Tongan kava, in turn from Proto-Polynesian *kawa. Doublet of ʻawa, ava, kawa, and yava.

parole.significato: The official currency of Tonga, equal to 100 seniti.
An inhibition or ban that results from social custom or emotional aversion.
parole.testo: Borrowed from Tongan tapu (“prohibited, sacred”), from Proto-Polynesian *tapu, from Proto-Oceanic *tabu, from Proto-Eastern Malayo-Polynesian *tambu. Doublet of kapu. First attested in c. 1777. The p in the Tongan source was misheard as b.

parole.significato: A kind of cloth prepared by the Polynesians from the inner bark of the paper mulberry.
